summary: To create a self-service RBAC role, log in as an AAP administrator, go to Administration > RBAC, click Create, name the role, pick teams and users, select plug-ins under Add Permission policies, configure fine-grained permissions, click Next, review, and Create. The Members column counts team members plus admins.
questions: How do I create an RBAC role in self-service automation portal?
Where is the RBAC menu in self-service automation portal?
What does the Members column count in self-service RBAC?

answer_card.title: Create a self-service RBAC role
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Log in as a user with AAP administrator privileges.
2. Go to **Administration > RBAC** and click **Create**.
3. Enter a role name.
4. Under **Users and Groups**, select the AAP teams and users.
5. Under **Add Permission policies**, select plug-ins; choose **Permission** to set fine-grained policies.
6. Click **Next**, review, then **Create**.
